map.清洁用品消耗量与补货周期 使用指南: Cleaning Supplies Consumption and Reorder Cycle User Guide
map.登记清洁用品的单位、库存、消耗速率与补货阈值，自动推算补货周期与建议下单量，辅助: Register units, stock, consumption rate and reorder threshold for cleaning supplies to auto-derive the reorder cycle and suggested order quantity, assisting household or office consumables management.
map.日耗量 = 消耗速率 ÷ 周期天数（周=7 / 月=30）；可用天数 = ⌊库存: Daily consumption = consumption rate ÷ cycle days (week=7 / month=30); days remaining = ⌊stock ÷ daily consumption⌋; reorder cycle = ⌊threshold ÷ daily consumption⌋
map.把「每周期消耗量」折算为日耗量后，用当前库存估算可用天数、用补货阈值估算应下单的: Convert per-cycle consumption to a daily rate, then use current stock to estimate days remaining and the reorder threshold to estimate the interval before ordering. Stock ≤ threshold is judged "low stock"; days remaining ≤ 7 is judged "nearly depleted".
map.登记洗洁精、纸巾、垃圾袋等耗材的单位、库存、消耗速率与补货阈值，自动推算还能用多: Register units, stock, consumption rate and reorder threshold for consumables like detergent, tissue and bin bags, and the tool works out how long they will last and when to order.
map.家庭或办公室盘点耗材时，把临近补货阈值的用品一次性列出来，集中采购。: When taking inventory at home or in the office, list all items near the reorder threshold together and buy in one order.
map.根据实际消耗修正速率参数，让补货提醒更贴合真实使用节奏。: Correct the rate parameters from actual consumption so reorder reminders match the real usage rhythm.
map.：库存 12 卷、消耗速率 6 卷/月、补货阈值 4 卷：日耗量 = 6÷30: : stock 12 rolls, consumption 6 rolls/month, reorder threshold 4 rolls: daily consumption = 6÷30 = 0.2 rolls/day, days remaining = ⌊12÷0.2⌋ = 60 days, reorder cycle = ⌊4÷0.2⌋ = 20 days — so stock hits the threshold in about 20 days and an order should be placed.
map.：某用品按「周」设置速率 3 件、库存 10 件：日耗量 = 3÷7 ≈ 0.4: : an item set to 3 pieces per week with 10 in stock: daily consumption = 3÷7 ≈ 0.43 pieces/day, about 23 days remaining; the same item mistakenly set to 3 per month gives about 100 days — the wrong convention significantly overestimates availability.
map.保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传服务器；清除浏览器数据会一并清除，重要清单建议另行: Stored in browser local storage and never uploaded to the server; clearing browser data removes it too, so back up important lists separately.
map.消耗速率填不准怎么办？: What if I cannot enter the consumption rate accurately?
map.可先用一段时间的实际消耗反推：速率 = 期间消耗量 ÷ 期间天数 × 周期天数，: You can back out the rate from actual consumption over a period: rate = consumption in period ÷ days in period × cycle days, then fill it in and calibrate progressively.
map.阈值决定提前多久提醒，通常预留一次采购到货周期即可，例如补货需 3 天则阈值约为: The threshold sets how far ahead to remind — usually one procurement lead time, e.g. if replenishment takes 3 days the threshold is about 3 days of consumption.
